notes.title: QoL update: units will auto combine on bench after buying from shop
notes.content:
1) Now units will auto combine on bench after buying from shop.

But the logic is a bit simplified. It doesn't take into account units on the board, only units on the bench.

E.g. it needs to have other 2 units on the bench to combine. If only 1 unit is on the bench, the other is on the board, it doesn't combine. 

This should improve the QoL a little.

2) Reduced damage of enemy bosses, was too powerful.

3) (new) nerf one of the 3 bosses called UNDEAD LORD, made it melee, made it able to receive negative status effects from attack with passives, e.g. stuns, phase out. Previously it was immune to phys attacks with passives.
